sections.Description:
Stern’s Foo Fighters machines bring the Foo Fighters concert experience home as players are immersed in an epic pinball adventure.

An entire new universe has been developed with jaw-dropping hand-drawn artwork and custom animations including “Foo Fighters Saturday Morning Action Time!”—a fictional TV series chronicling the band’s quest to save rock and roll… AND THE WORLD!
sections.Gameplay Features:
- Battle the Overlord: Join Foo Fighters on this rescue mission to thwart the evil, mysterious alien Overlord and his army of bots.
- Access Area 51: Search the Area 51 upper playfield to break into and unleash pinball chaos.
- The Iconic Van: Jump in the van for a righteous tour of duty to save humanity from extinction and let rock rule!
sections.Editions:
Pro:
- Foo Fighters playfield and full cabinet Artwork by Zombie Yeti.
- Featuring 15 iconic Foo Fighters songs including This is a Call, Walk, Learn to Fly, All My Life, & more.
- A new inlane design with Inlane "Ray Gun" targets.

Premium:
- Featuring 15 iconic Foo Fighters songs including Best of You, My Hero, I'll Stick Around, The Pretender & more.
- Premium Edition full color translite featuring Foo Fighters, the Overlord, and the FooBot; illustrated by Zombie Yeti.
- Powder-coated steel bottom arch with powder-coated black wrinkle finish side armor, hinges, front lockdown molding and legs.

Limited Edition:
- Upgraded speaker system with 3-channel amplifier.
- Custom high gloss "Overlord Green" powder-coated pinball armor, legs, hinges and action button front molding.
- Laser-cut Foo Fighters logo armor, with neon-green underlay.
